WITH hs_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    s.ncessch,
    s.sch_name,
    s.gr_span_low,
    s.gr_span_high,
    s.gr_low_enroll,
    s.gr_high_enroll,
    s.status,
    s.ncesdist,
    -- String comparisons to order grades: 'PK'<K<1<2...
    CASE
      WHEN s.gr_low_enroll = 'PK' THEN 0
      WHEN s.gr_low_enroll = 'KG' THEN 1
      WHEN CAST(s.gr_low_enroll AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 2
      WHEN CAST(s.gr_low_enroll AS INTEGER) > 1 THEN 1 + CAST(s.gr_low_enroll AS INTEGER)
      ELSE 100 -- catch-all for odd cases
    END AS gr_low_rank
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.ncesdist = '0613360'
    AND s.status = '1'
    AND (s.gr_span_high = '12' OR s.gr_high_enroll = '12')
    AND s.gr_high_enroll = '12' -- must actually enroll students in grade 12
),
sat_free_hs AS (
  SELECT h.ncessch, h.sch_name, h.gr_span_low, h.gr_span_high, h.gr_low_enroll, h.gr_high_enroll, h.gr_low_rank
  FROM hs_candidates h
  LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON ss.ncessch = h.ncessch
  WHERE COALESCE(ss.num_testtakers, 0) = 0
)
SELECT sch_name, gr_span_low, gr_span_high
FROM sat_free_hs
WHERE gr_low_rank = (SELECT MIN(gr_low_rank) FROM sat_free_hs)
ORDER BY sch_name;

WITH state_board_schools AS (
  SELECT school_id, name, admin_email
  FROM schools
  WHERE district_ownership_type = 'State Board of Education'
),
high_scorers AS (
  SELECT s.school_id, s.name, s.admin_email, COUNT(*) AS score_1500_or_over

  GROUP BY s.school_id, s.name, s.admin_email
),
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(score_1500_or_over) AS max_score
  FROM high_scorers
)
SELECT h.name AS school_name, h.admin_email
FROM high_scorers h
JOIN max_count m ON h.score_1500_or_over = m.max_score;

WITH active_charters AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.school_name,
    s.charter_funding AS funding_category,
    s.status AS school_status,
    s.k12_enr_2014_15 AS enrollment_2014_15,
    s.k12_frpm_pct_2014_15 AS frpm_pct_2014_15
  FROM
    schools s
  WHERE
    s.charter_funding IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
    AND s.status = 'Open'
    AND s.charter_flag = 1
),
sat_scores AS (
  SELECT
    sc.school_id,
    COALESCE(ss.avg_reading, 0) + COALESCE(ss.avg_math, 0) + COALESCE(ss.avg_writing, 0) AS combined_sat
  FROM
    satscores ss
    JOIN schools sc ON ss.school_id = sc.school_id
  WHERE
    ss.avg_reading IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.avg_math IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.avg_writing IS NOT NULL
),
charters_with_sat AS (
  SELECT
    ac.school_id,
    ac.funding_category,
    ac.enrollment_2014_15,
    ac.frpm_pct_2014_15,
    sat.combined_sat
  FROM
    active_charters ac
    LEFT JOIN sat_scores sat ON ac.school_id = sat.school_id
)
SELECT
  funding_category,
  COUNT(*) AS num_active_charter_schools,
  SUM(enrollment_2014_15) AS total_enrollment_2014_15,
  ROUND(AVG(frpm_pct_2014_15), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct_2014_15,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN combined_sat IS NOT NULL THEN combined_sat END), 2) AS avg_combined_sat
FROM
  charters_with_sat
GROUP BY
  funding_category
ORDER BY
  funding_category
;

WITH exclusively_virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    name,
    county,
    Virtual
  FROM schools
  WHERE Virtual = 'F'
),
county_counts AS (
  SELECT
    county,
    COUNT(*) AS num_virtual_schools
  FROM exclusively_virtual_schools
  GROUP BY county
),
ranked_counts AS (
  SELECT
    county,
    num_virtual_schools,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY num_virtual_schools DESC) AS county_rank
  FROM county_counts
),
top_counts AS (
  SELECT
    county,
    num_virtual_schools
  FROM ranked_counts
  WHERE num_virtual_schools >= (
    SELECT MIN(num_virtual_schools)
    FROM (
      SELECT num_virtual_schools
      FROM ranked_counts
      ORDER BY num_virtual_schools DESC
      LIMIT 5
    )

  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.SchoolName,
    s.CountyName,
    s.City,
    s.MailingStreet,
    s.MailingCity,
    s.MailingState,
    s.MailingZip,
    s.Website,
    s.K12Enrollment,
    f.FRPMEligible,
    f.FRPMEligible * 1.0 / s.K12Enrollment AS FRPMShare,
    s.OpenDate,
    s.CloseDate,
    CASE WHEN s.CloseDate IS NULL OR s.CloseDate = '' THEN 'open' ELSE 'closed' END AS Status
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE
    s.CharterYN = 'N'
    AND s.K12Enrollment > 100
),
sat_summary AS (
  SELECT
    sat.CDSCode,
    AVG(sat.SATCriticalReading + sat.SATMath + sat.SATWriting) AS AverageSAT,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (sat.SATCriticalReading + sat.SATMath + sat.SATWriting) >= 1500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS PctSAT1500
  FROM satscores sat
  WHERE 
    sat.SATCriticalReading IS NOT NULL
    AND sat.SATMath IS NOT NULL
    AND sat.SATWriting IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sat.CDSCode
),
-- Schools with the largest FRPM-eligible count (ties included)
max_frpm AS (
  SELECT
    es.*,
    ss.AverageSAT,
    ss.PctSAT1500,
    'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS label
  FROM eligible_schools es
  LEFT JOIN sat_summary ss ON es.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode
  WHERE es.FRPMEligible IS NOT NULL
    AND es.FRPMEligible = (
      SELECT MAX(FRPMEligible)
      FROM eligible_schools
      WHERE FRPMEligible IS NOT NULL
    )
),
-- Schools with the smallest FRPM share (ties included)
min_frpm_share AS (
  SELECT
    es.*,
    ss.AverageSAT,
    ss.PctSAT1500,
    'smallest FRPM share' AS label
  FROM eligible_schools es
  LEFT JOIN sat_summary ss ON es.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode
  WHERE es.FRPMShare IS NOT NULL
    AND es.FRPMShare = (
      SELECT MIN(FRPMShare)
      FROM eligible_schools
      WHERE FRPMShare IS NOT NULL
    )
),
-- The benchmark school by CDS code
benchmark AS (
  SELECT
    es.*,
    ss.AverageSAT,
    ss.PctSAT1500,
    'the CDS code from my notes' AS label
  FROM eligible_schools es
  LEFT JOIN sat_summary ss ON es.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode
  WHERE es.CDSCode = '4615150435602'
)
SELECT
  label,
  SchoolName,
  CountyName,
  City,
  MailingStreet,
  MailingCity,
  MailingState,
  MailingZip,
  Website,
  K12Enrollment,
  FRPMEligible,
  FRPMShare,
  AverageSAT,
  PctSAT1500,
  OpenDate,
  Status

SELECT
  label,

    FROM set_translations

    FROM sets s
    GROUP BY s.type
)

    num_sets_with_translation,
    total_cards_in_translated_sets
FROM sets_with_counts
ORDER BY set_type;

WITH
-- Identify the first set where Abyssal Horror was printed
abyssal_horror_sets AS (
  SELECT s.code, s.name, s.released_at
  FROM sets s
  JOIN cards c ON c.set_code = s.code
  WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
),
first_abyssal_set AS (
  SELECT code, name, released_at
  FROM abyssal_horror_sets
  WHERE (released_at, code) IN (
    SELECT MIN(released_at), MIN(code)
    FROM abyssal_horror_sets
    WHERE released_at = (SELECT MIN(released_at) FROM abyssal_horror_sets)
  )
),
-- Identify the most recently released set in the database
most_recent_set AS (
  SELECT code, name, released_at
  FROM sets
  WHERE (released_at, code) IN (
    SELECT MAX(released_at), MIN(code)
    FROM sets
    WHERE released_at = (SELECT MAX(released_at) FROM sets)
  )
),
relevant_sets AS (
  SELECT code, name FROM first_abyssal_set
  UNION ALL
  SELECT code, name FROM most_recent_set
),
card_data AS (
  SELECT
    c.id AS card_id,
    c.set_code,
    c.mana_value,
    c.mana_cost
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.set_code IN (SELECT code FROM relevant_sets)
),
mana_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.name AS set_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cards_with_mana_cost,
    SUM(CASE WHEN card_data.mana_value <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cheap_cards
  FROM relevant_sets s
  JOIN card_data ON card_data.set_code = s.code
  WHERE card_data.mana_cost IS NOT NULL AND card_data.mana_cost != ''
  GROUP BY s.name
)
SELECT
  set_name,
  ROUND(
    CAST(cheap_cards AS REAL) * 100.0 / total_cards_with_mana_cost,
    2
  ) AS percent_low_cmc
FROM mana_stats;

Please give me the card's name, its collector number, and how many foreign-language printings exist for that card. If several Abzan-watermarked cards tie for the highest collector number, list every one of them, each with its own count of foreign-language printings. Count each foreign-language edition record of the card as one printing.

BIRD evidence:
Abzan watermark: the clan mark printed on the card. Collector number: the number of the card within the set it was printed in. Foreign-language printing: the foreign-language edition record of a card.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

```sql
WITH abzan_cards AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.name, c.collector_number, c.set_code
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.watermark = 'Abzan'
),
max_collector AS (
  SELECT set_code, MAX(CAST(collector_number AS INTEGER)) AS max_num
  FROM abzan_cards
  GROUP BY set_code
),
last_abzan_cards AS (
  SELECT a.id, a.name, a.collector_number, a.set_code
  FROM abzan_cards a
  JOIN max_collector m
    ON a.set_code = m.set_code
   AND CAST(a.collector_number AS INTEGER) = m.max_num
)
SELECT
  l.name,
  l.collector_number,
  COUNT(f.id) AS foreign_language_printings
FROM last_abzan_cards l
LEFT JOIN foreign_data f
  ON f.card_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.id, l.name, l.collector_number
ORDER BY l.set_code, l.collector_number
```

WITH tarmogoyf_printings AS (
  SELECT
    c.id AS card_id,
    c.name,
    c.set_code,
    c.frame_version
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
),
sets_with_frames AS (
  SELECT
    t.card_id,
    t.set_code,
    t.frame_version,
    s.name AS set_name,
    s.release_date
  FROM tarmogoyf_printings t
  JOIN sets s ON t.set_code = s.code
  WHERE
    -- Only consider printings with both a frame version and release date
    t.frame_version IS NOT NULL
    AND s.release_date IS NOT NULL
),
qualified_reprints AS (
  SELECT
    set_name,
    release_date,
    frame_version,
    CAST(substr(s.release_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS release_year,
    (CAST(substr(s.release_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - t.frame_version) AS frame_age_years
  FROM sets_with_frames s
  JOIN tarmogoyf_printings t
    ON s.card_id = t.card_id
    AND s.set_code = t.set_code

WITH set_langs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT language
  FROM set_translations
),
flavor_text_lang_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.flavor_text_language AS language,
    COUNT(*) AS printing_count
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.flavor_text_language IN (SELECT language FROM set_langs)
    AND c.flavor_text IS NOT NULL AND c.flavor_text != ''
  GROUP BY c.flavor_text_language
)
SELECT
  l.language,
  f.printing_count
FROM set_langs l
LEFT JOIN flavor_text_lang_counts f ON l.language = f.language
WHERE f.printing_count = (
  SELECT MIN(printing_count)
  FROM flavor_text_lang_counts
)
ORDER BY l.language ASC;

WITH germany_users AS (
    SELECT id, reputation
    FROM users
    WHERE location LIKE '%Germany%'
),
posts_2012 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM posts
    WHERE strftime('%Y', creationDate) = '2012'
),
post_last_editors AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS post_id,
        p.score,
        ph.userId AS last_editor_id
    FROM posts_2012 p
    JOIN postHistory ph
        ON ph.postId = p.id
    WHERE ph.creationDate = (
        SELECT MAX(ph2.creationDate)
        FROM postHistory ph2
        WHERE ph2.postId = p.id
    )
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN ge.id IS NOT NULL THEN ple.score ELSE 0 END) AS germany_last_edit_score_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ge.id IS NULL THEN ple.score ELSE 0 END) AS other_last_edit_score_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ge.id) AS num_germany_last_editors,
    COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ge.reputation), 0) AS germany_last_editors_total_reputation
FROM post_last_editors ple
LEFT JOIN germany_users ge ON ple.last_editor_id = ge.id

WITH german_users AS (
  SELECT id, displayName
  FROM users
  WHERE location LIKE '%Germany%'

user_badge_counts AS (
  SELECT u.id, u.displayName, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_total

  LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userId

),
max_badge_total AS (

  FROM user_badge_counts

)

FROM user_badge_counts ubc
JOIN second_max_badge_total smbt ON ubc.badge_total = smbt.second_top
ORDER BY ubc.displayName;

WITH answer_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        parentid AS question_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_answers
    FROM posts
    WHERE parentid IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY parentid

    SELECT
        pl.relatedpostid AS post_id,

    WHERE pl.creationdate >= '2010-01-01'

    LEFT JOIN answer_counts ac ON lp.post_id = ac.question_id

),
months AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', date('2010-01-01', '+' || (n - 1) || ' months')) AS month_2010
    FROM (
        SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
        UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 
        UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
    )
)

FROM (
    SELECT
        m.month_2010,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fp.post_id) AS cnt
    FROM months m
    LEFT JOIN filtered_posts fp ON m.month_2010 = fp.link_month
    GROUP BY m.month_2010
)

WITH risky_teams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
),
candidate_clubs AS (
  SELECT t.team_api_id, t.short_name
  FROM Team t
  INNER JOIN risky_teams r ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
),
short_names_with_multiple_clubs AS (
  SELECT short_name
  FROM candidate_clubs
  GROUP BY short_name
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id) > 1
),
ccp_at_given_date AS (
  SELECT ta.team_api_id,
         ta.chanceCreationPassing,
         ta.date,
         t.short_name,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id
           ORDER BY ABS(strftime('%s', ta.date) - strftime('%s', '2014-09-19')) ASC
         ) as rn
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
  INNER JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
  WHERE t.short_name IN (SELECT short_name FROM short_names_with_multiple_clubs)
)
SELECT
  t.short_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) AS num_clubs,
  ROUND(AVG(a.chanceCreationPassing * 1.0), 1) AS avg_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM candidate_clubs t
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT team_api_id, short_name, chanceCreationPassing
  FROM ccp_at_given_date
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND date <= '2014-09-19'
  -- Accepts attribute record in force on or before the date; if none, then attribute after the date will be picked
  UNION ALL
  SELECT team_api_id, short_name, chanceCreationPassing
  FROM ccp_at_given_date
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND team_api_id NOT IN (
      SELECT team_api_id
      FROM ccp_at_given_date
      WHERE rn = 1
        AND date <= '2014-09-19'
    )
) a ON t.team_api_id = a.team_api_id
GROUP BY t.short_name
ORDER BY avg_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC, t.short_name ASC

Among those, I want the short names that are carried by more than one club. For each such short name, please give me: the short name, the number of clubs that carry it, and the average chance creation passing risk of those clubs that was in force on 19 September 2014, rounded to one decimal place. Sort the results by that average, highest first; if two averages are the same, order them alphabetically by short name.

BIRD evidence:
A team's chance creation passing class is 'Risky' when chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'; its chance creation passing risk is the chanceCreationPassing value in force on the date in question.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

```sql
WITH risky_teams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
),
candidate_clubs AS (
  SELECT t.team_api_id, t.short_name
  FROM Team t
  INNER JOIN risky_teams r ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
),
short_names_with_multiple_clubs AS (
  SELECT short_name
  FROM candidate_clubs
  GROUP BY short_name
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id) > 1
),
ccp_at_given_date AS (
  SELECT ta.team_api_id,
         ta.chanceCreationPassing,
         ta.date,
         t.short_name,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id
           ORDER BY ABS(strftime('%s', ta.date) - strftime('%s', '2014-09-19')) ASC
         ) as rn
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
  INNER JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id

  COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) AS num_clubs,
  ROUND(AVG(a.chanceCreationPassing * 1.0), 1) AS avg_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM candidate_clubs t

  SELECT team_api_id, short_name, chanceCreationPassing
  FROM ccp_at_given_date

WITH HomeMatches AS (
    SELECT
        m.id AS match_id,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        m.match_api_id,
        m.date,
        m.home_team_goal,
        m.away_team_goal
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
),
FastBuildUpTeams AS (
    SELECT
        ta.team_api_id,
        ta.date,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
),
RankedTeamAttributes AS (
    SELECT
        hm.*,
        ta.date AS attr_date,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY hm.match_id
            ORDER BY ta.date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM HomeMatches hm
    JOIN FastBuildUpTeams ta
        ON hm.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
        AND ta.date <= hm.date
),
HomeWinsWithFastBuildUp AS (
    SELECT
        rta.team_api_id,
        rta.match_id
    FROM RankedTeamAttributes rta
    WHERE rta.rn = 1
          AND rta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
)
SELECT
    t.team_long_name AS club_name,
    t.team_short_name AS short_name,
    COUNT(hwwfbu.match_id) AS num_home_3plus_goal_wins_with_fast_buildup
FROM HomeWinsWithFastBuildUp hwwfbu
JOIN Team t
    ON hwwfbu.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
HAVING COUNT(hwwfbu.match_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(wins) FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(hwwfbu2.match_id) AS wins
        FROM HomeWinsWithFastBuildUp hwwfbu2
        GROUP BY hwwfbu2.team_api_id
    )
)
ORDER BY club_name

WITH LatestPlayerAttributes AS (
  SELECT
    pa.player_id,
    pa.id AS attr_id,
    pa.date,
    pa.volley
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      player_id,
      MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_id
  ) latest_date
  ON pa.player_id = latest_date.player_id AND pa.date = latest_date.max_date
), UniqueLatestPlayerAttributes AS (
  SELECT
    lpa.player_id,
    lpa.volley
  FROM LatestPlayerAttributes lpa
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      player_id,
      date,
      MAX(attr_id) as max_attr_id
    FROM LatestPlayerAttributes
    GROUP BY player_id, date
  ) grouped
  ON lpa.player_id = grouped.player_id AND lpa.date = grouped.date AND lpa.attr_id = grouped.max_attr_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_players
FROM Player p
INNER JOIN UniqueLatestPlayerAttributes ulpa ON p.player_api_id = ulpa.player_id
WHERE p.height > 180 AND ulpa.volley > 70;

By what percentage was his overall rating on 12 July 2013 higher than the average overall rating across all players on that same calendar date, considering every player with the overall rating they carried on that date (not only those updated that day), among players rated low, medium or high for defensive work rate? Return one value only: that percentage, rounded to two decimals (e.g. 12.34 meaning 12.34% higher).

BIRD evidence:
Defensive work rate: a player's intensity of work in defense, rated low, medium or high. Overall rating: the overall score given to a player in the ratings.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

```sql
WITH all_attrs AS (
  SELECT
    pa.player_api_id,
    pa.overall_rating,
    pa.defensive_work_rate,
    pa.date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id
      ORDER BY pa.date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  WHERE pa.date <= '2013-07-12'
),
latest_attrs AS (
  SELECT
    a.player_api_id,
    a.overall_rating,
    a.defensive_work_rate
  FROM all_attrs a
  WHERE a.rn = 1
    AND a.overall_rating IS NOT NULL
    AND a.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
),
donovan_id AS (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM Player
  WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
  LIMIT 1
),
donovan_rating AS (
  SELECT la.overall_rating
  FROM latest_attrs la
  JOIN donovan_id d ON la.player_api_id = d.player_api_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    (
      (dr.overall_rating - avg(la.overall_rating)) * 100.0
      / avg(la.overall_rating)
    ), 2
  ) AS percentage_higher
FROM latest_attrs la
JOIN donovan_rating dr
```

WITH running_debt_loans AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.status = 'D'
),
districts_with_unemployment AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A11 AS unemployment_1995, d.A12 AS unemployment_1996
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A11 IS NOT NULL AND d.A12 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    d.district_name,
    ROUND(
        (d.unemployment_1996 - d.unemployment_1995) * 100.0 / NULLIF(d.unemployment_1995, 0)
    , 2) AS unemployment_rate_percentage_change
FROM districts_with_unemployment d
JOIN running_debt_loans rdl ON d.district_id = rdl.district_id
ORDER BY unemployment_rate_percentage_change DESC

WITH first_month AS (
    SELECT 
        STRFTIME('%Y-%m', MIN(date)) AS first_month
    FROM account
),
accounts_first_month AS (
    SELECT a.*, d.district_id, d.name AS district_name, d.A2 AS population
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    CROSS JOIN first_month fm
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m', a.date) = fm.first_month
),
districts_with_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id, district_name, population
    FROM accounts_first_month
),
max_population AS (
    SELECT MAX(population) AS max_pop FROM districts_with_accounts
)
SELECT d.district_name, d.population AS inhabitants
FROM districts_with_accounts d
JOIN max_population m ON d.population = m.max_pop;

WITH loans_active_on_19951231 AS (
  SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount,
    d.district_id,
    d.A2 AS region_name,
    date(l.date) AS approval_date,
    date(l.date, printf('+%d months', l.duration)) AS end_date
  FROM loan l
  JOIN client c ON l.account_id = c.account_id
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE
    date(l.date) <= '1995-12-31'
    AND date(l.date, printf('+%d months', l.duration)) >= '1995-12-31'
    AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')
)
SELECT
  region_name,
  SUM(amount) AS total_approved_amount
FROM loans_active_on_19951231
GROUP BY region_name
HAVING SUM(amount) = (
  SELECT MAX(total)
  FROM (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total
    FROM loans_active_on_19951231
    GROUP BY region_name
  )
)
ORDER BY region_name

    FROM client
    WHERE sex = 'M'
      AND (CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) + 1900 BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976)

            ELSE NULL
        END AS payment_type
    FROM large_payments
)
SELECT
    SUM(payment_type = 'household') AS household_payments,
    SUM(payment_type = 'other') AS other_purpose_payments
FROM purpose_classification;

I'm putting together a periodic report on large payments made by a specific customer cohort, split by what the payment was for. Among payments over $4000 (strictly more than $4000) made from the accounts of male customers born between 1974 and 1976, I need two figures: how many were household payments, and how many were made for a purpose other than household payment. A few rules to keep in mind: born between 1974 and 1976 means the birth year is 1974, 1975 or 1976; a customer's accounts are the ones they hold a disposition on; payments are the individual transactions executed on the account, not standing payment orders; a payment counts as other-purpose only if it has a recorded purpose different from household payment, and a payment with no purpose recorded counts in neither bucket.

BIRD evidence:
SIPO stands for household payment.

```sql
WITH male_customers_74_76 AS (
    SELECT client.client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE sex = 'M'
      AND (CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) + 1900 BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976)
),
accounts_of_customers AS (
    SELECT disp.account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE disp.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM male_customers_74_76)
),
large_payments AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount, t.type, t.operation, t.purpose
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_of_customers)
      AND t.amount > 4000
      AND t.type = 'debit'
),
purpose_classification AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN purpose = 'SIPO' THEN 'household'
            WHEN purpose IS NOT NULL AND purpose != 'SIPO' THEN 'other'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS payment_type
    FROM large_payments
)
SELECT
    SUM(payment_type = 'household') AS household_payments,
    SUM(payment_type = 'other') AS other_purpose_payments
FROM purpose_classification;
```

WITH prachatice_branch AS (
    SELECT account_id, account_id AS acct_no, district_id AS branch_district_id, date AS acct_open_date
    FROM account
    WHERE district_id = (

    )

loan_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM loan
),
borrowing_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.acct_no, a.acct_open_date

    SELECT d.account_id, c.district_id AS client_district_id, d.disp_id, c.client_id

),

    SELECT awd.*, dist.A3 AS district_name, dist.A2 AS district_city, dist.A4 AS region, dist.A10 AS population
    FROM acct_with_district awd
    LEFT JOIN district dist ON awd.client_district_id = dist.district_id
),

loan_amount_sum AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),

      AND t.account2 IS NOT NULL
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account2 != '' AND t.bank != '' -- must be interbank
      AND t.operation IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') -- incoming/outgoing transfer
),
acct_counterparty_count AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account2 || '-' || bank) AS outside_counterparty_count
    FROM relevant_trans
    GROUP BY account_id

    home_district_population,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, acct_no ASC) AS population_rank

WITH gold_cards AS (
  SELECT card.card_id, card.disp_id, disp.account_id
  FROM card
  JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
  WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
avg_balances AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
eligible_accounts AS (
  SELECT gc.account_id, disp.client_id
  FROM gold_cards gc
  JOIN avg_balances ab ON gc.account_id = ab.account_id
  JOIN disp ON gc.account_id = disp.account_id
  WHERE ab.avg_balance > 1000 AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
account_branches AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
),
qualified_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ab.district_id
  FROM eligible_accounts ea
  JOIN account_branches ab ON ea.account_id = ab.account_id
  JOIN district d ON ab.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.inhabitants > 100000
),
district_by_gender AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.name AS district_name, d.inhabitants, d.avg_salary, d.ratio_urban, c.gender
  FROM qualified_districts qd
  JOIN district d ON qd.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN account_branches ab ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
  JOIN eligible_accounts ea ON ab.account_id = ea.account_id
  JOIN client c ON ea.client_id = c.client_id
),
per_gender AS (
  SELECT
    gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT district_id) AS num_districts,
    MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants
  FROM district_by_gender
  GROUP BY gender
),
top_districts AS (
  SELECT gender, district_id, district_name, inhabitants
  FROM (
    SELECT
      gender,
      district_id,
      district_name,
      inhabitants,
      RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY inhabitants DESC) as rn
    FROM district_by_gender
    GROUP BY gender, district_id
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
avg_salary_urban AS (
  SELECT
    gender,
    ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT avg_salary),2) AS avg_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT ratio_urban),2) AS avg_urban_ratio
  FROM district_by_gender
  GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT
  g.gender,
  p.num_districts,
  t.district_name AS most_inhabited_district,
  t.inhabitants AS most_inhabitants,
  a.avg_salary,
  a.avg_urban_ratio
FROM per_gender p
JOIN top_districts t ON p.gender = t.gender AND p.max_inhabitants = t.inhabitants
JOIN avg_salary_urban a ON p.gender = a.gender
WHERE g.gender = 'F'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  g.gender,
  p.num_districts,
  t.district_name AS most_inhabited_district,
  t.inhabitants AS most_inhabitants,
  a.avg_salary,
  a.avg_urban_ratio
FROM per_gender p
JOIN top_districts t ON p.gender = t.gender AND p.max_inhabitants = t.inhabitants
JOIN avg_salary_urban a ON p.gender = a.gender
WHERE g.gender = 'M'
ORDER BY gender, most_inhabitants DESC, most_inhabited_district;

  FROM trans t

  FROM account a

qualified_districts AS (

),

      district_id,

      inhabitants,

    FROM district_by_gender
    GROUP BY gender, district_id
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),

  SELECT
    gender,
    ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT avg_salary),2) AS avg_salary,

  FROM district_by_gender
  GROUP BY gender
)

  t.inhabitants AS most_inhabitants,

WITH female_owner_clients AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id, 
        c.district_id, 
        d.account_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
clients_with_card AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.client_id, f.district_id, f.account_id
    FROM female_owner_clients f
    JOIN card ca ON ca.disp_id = (
        SELECT disp_id 
        FROM disp 
        WHERE account_id = f.account_id 
          AND client_id = f.client_id 
        LIMIT 1
    )
),
clients_with_card_and_loan AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id, c.account_id
    FROM clients_with_card c
    JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = c.account_id
),
districts_with_target_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, di.region
    FROM clients_with_card_and_loan d
    JOIN district di ON d.district_id = di.district_id
),
region_district_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        di.region,
        di.district_id,
        di.A96_average_salary AS avg_salary,
        di.A96_unemploymant_rate AS unemployment_rate,
        di.A96_inhabitants AS inhabitants,
        di.name AS district_name
    FROM district di
    JOIN districts_with_target_clients t 
        ON di.district_id = t.district_id
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
        ROUND(AVG(unemployment_rate), 2) AS avg_district_unemployment,
        -- get most populous district per region
        district_name AS most_populous_district,
        inhabitants
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            region, 
            avg_salary, 
            unemployment_rate, 
            inhabitants,
            district_name,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY region 
                ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC
            ) as rn
        FROM region_district_agg
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY region, district_name, inhabitants
)
SELECT 
    region,
    avg_district_salary,
    avg_district_unemployment,
    most_populous_district
FROM region_stats
ORDER BY region;

Disposition type OWNER means the client owns the account. Unemployment rate in 1996 is the district's unemployment rate for 1996; average salary is the district's average salary.

WITH female_owner_clients AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id, 
        c.district_id, 
        d.account_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
clients_with_card AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.client_id, f.district_id, f.account_id
    FROM female_owner_clients f
    JOIN card ca ON ca.disp_id = (
        SELECT disp_id 
        FROM disp 
        WHERE account_id = f.account_id 
          AND client_id = f.client_id 
        LIMIT 1
    )
),
clients_with_card_and_loan AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id, c.account_id
    FROM clients_with_card c
    JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = c.account_id
),
districts_with_target_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, di.region
    FROM clients_with_card_and_loan d
    JOIN district di ON d.district_id = di.district_id
),

        di.region,
        di.district_id,
        di.A96_average_salary AS avg_salary,
        di.A96_unemploymant_rate AS unemployment_rate,
        di.A96_inhabitants AS inhabitants,
        di.name AS district_name
    FROM district di
    JOIN districts_with_target_clients t 
        ON di.district_id = t.district_id
),

    SELECT
        region,

)

FROM region_stats
ORDER BY region;

WITH litomerice_region AS (
  SELECT region
  FROM district
  WHERE district_name = 'Litomerice'
  LIMIT 1
), acc_1996 AS (
  -- Accounts opened in 1996 in the region of Litomerice, with their districts.
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN litomerice_region lr ON d.region = lr.region
  WHERE a.date_opened >= '1996-01-01' AND a.date_opened <= '1996-12-31'
), last_trans AS (
  -- For accounts opened in 1996, get the last transaction on or before 1996-12-31
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.trans_id,
    t.balance
  FROM (
    SELECT
      account_id,
      MAX(trans_date) AS last_date
    FROM trans
    WHERE trans_date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
  ) ltd
  JOIN trans t
    ON t.account_id = ltd.account_id AND t.trans_date = ltd.last_date
  -- If multiple transactions on that date, pick the one with max trans_id
  WHERE t.trans_id = (
    SELECT MAX(trans_id) FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = t.account_id AND trans_date = t.trans_date
  )
), acc_balances AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    d.district_name,
    d.region,
    COALESCE(lt.balance, 0) AS end1996_balance -- Assume 0 if no transaction up to end 1996
  FROM acc_1996 a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN last_trans lt ON a.account_id = lt.account_id
), stats_by_district AS (
  SELECT
    district_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_accounts_1996,
    ROUND(AVG(end1996_balance), 2) AS avg_end1996_balance
  FROM acc_balances
  GROUP BY district_name
)
SELECT
  sbd.district_name,
  sbd.num_accounts_1996,
  sbd.avg_end1996_balance,
  region_avg.region_wide_avg_end1996_balance,
  max_district.max_avg_district_name
FROM stats_by_district sbd

WITH major_districts AS (
  SELECT district_id, name AS district_name, A2 AS region, A3 AS population
  FROM district
  WHERE A3 >= 100000
),
accounts_in_district AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  WHERE a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM major_districts)
),
withdrawals_by_account AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, t.account_id, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM trans t
  JOIN accounts_in_district a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY a.district_id, t.account_id
),
withdrawals_by_district AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, SUM(w.total_withdrawn) AS district_withdrawn
  FROM major_districts d
  LEFT JOIN withdrawals_by_account w ON d.district_id = w.district_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id
  HAVING district_withdrawn > 0
),
withdrawals_per_inhabitant AS (
  SELECT d.district_id,
         d.district_name,
         d.region,
         d.population,
         wd.district_withdrawn,
         ROUND(CAST(wd.district_withdrawn AS FLOAT) / d.population, 2) AS withdrawn_per_inhabitant
  FROM major_districts d
  JOIN withdrawals_by_district wd ON d.district_id = wd.district_id
),
standing_orders_per_account AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, 
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol IS NOT NULL THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS standing_order_debit
  FROM accounts_in_district a
  LEFT JOIN "order" o ON a.account_id = o.account_id AND o.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id
),
avg_standing_order_per_district AS (
  SELECT d.district_id,
         ROUND(CAST(SUM(s.standing_order_debit) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(s.account_id), 2) AS avg_so_debit_per_account
  FROM major_districts d
  LEFT JOIN standing_orders_per_account s ON d.district_id = s.district_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id
),
final_table AS (
  SELECT 
    wpi.district_name,
    wpi.region,
    wpi.population,
    wpi.district_withdrawn,
    wpi.withdrawn_per_inhabitant,
    a.avg_so_debit_per_account
  FROM withdrawals_per_inhabitant wpi
  JOIN avg_standing_order_per_district a ON wpi.district_id = a.district_id
),
ranked_table AS (
  SELECT *,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawn_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawal_pressure_rank
  FROM final_table
)
SELECT 
  district_name,
  region,
  population,
  district_withdrawn,
  withdrawn_per_inhabitant,
  withdrawal_pressure_rank,
  avg_so_debit_per_account
FROM ranked_table
ORDER BY withdrawal_pressure_rank, district_name;

sql:
WITH female_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_number, d.district_id, d.region
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
loan_with_clients AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,
        fc.client_id,
        fc.birth_number,
        fc.district_id AS client_district_id,
        fc.region AS client_region
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp dp ON l.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN female_clients fc ON dp.client_id = fc.client_id
),
approved_loans AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM loan_with_clients
    WHERE status = 'A'
),
largest_loans AS (
    SELECT *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM approved_loans
),
top3loans AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM largest_loans
    WHERE amount_rank <= 3
    -- includes ties naturally
),
accounts_branches AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.district_id,
        d.district_name,
        d.region
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
account_txn_stats AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loans_per_region AS (
    SELECT
        d.region,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_in_region
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.region
),
avg_salary_by_region AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        ROUND(AVG(average_salary), 2) AS avg_avg_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY region
),
-- Calculate completed age as of 2026-10-09
age_calc AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        -- birth_number: YYMMDDxxxx
        -- extract year, month, day, and handle pre-1954 birthdates as needed
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 3, 2) > '54'
                THEN '19' || SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 1, 2)
                ELSE '19' || SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 1, 2)
            END
            AS INTEGER
        ) AS year_birth,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) > 50
                THEN CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) - 50
                ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 3, 2) AS INTEGER)
            END
            AS INTEGER
        ) AS month_birth,
        CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS day_birth
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
age_completed AS (
    SELECT
        client_id,
        (
            2026 - year_birth - 
            CASE
                WHEN (month_birth > 10 OR (month_birth = 10 AND day_birth > 9)) THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS completed_age_on_2026_10_09
    FROM age_calc
)
SELECT
    t.loan_id,
    t.client_id,
    ROUND(t.amount, 2) AS loan_amount,
    t.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND(t.payments * t.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(t.payments * t.duration - t.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    t.status AS loan_status,
    ab.district_name AS account_district,
    ab.region AS account_region,
    COALESCE(ts.txn_count, 0) AS account_transaction_count,
    COALESCE(ROUND(ts.total_deposits, 2), 0) AS account_total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * t.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_deposits, 0) > t.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    lpr.loans_in_region,
    asbr.avg_avg_salary AS region_avg_salary,
    ac.completed_age_on_2026_10_09
FROM top3loans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN accounts_branches ab ON a.account_id = ab.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_txn_stats ts ON t.account_id = ts.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans_per_region lpr ON ab.region = lpr.region
LEFT JOIN avg_salary_by_region asbr ON ab.region = asbr.region
LEFT JOIN age_completed ac ON t.client_id = ac.client_id
ORDER BY t.amount DESC

WITH gold_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND c.ctype = 'credit'
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id
),
district_info AS (
  SELECT district_id, name AS district_name, region
  FROM district
),
loan_counts AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
),
trans_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
external_counterparties AS (
  -- Counterparty accounts at other banks for both PRIJEM (credit) and VYDAJ (debit)
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank) AS ext_counterparty_count
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.bank IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.bank) <> ''
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
main AS (
  SELECT
    ga.account_id,
    di.district_name,
    di.region,
    COALESCE(ts.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
    COALESCE(ts.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(lc.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(ec.ext_counterparty_count, 0) AS external_counterparties
  FROM gold_accounts ga
  LEFT JOIN district_info di ON ga.district_id = di.district_id
  LEFT JOIN trans_summary ts ON ga.account_id = ts.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_counts lc ON ga.account_id = lc.account_id
  LEFT JOIN external_counterparties ec ON ga.account_id = ec.account_id
)
SELECT
  account_id,
  district_name,
  region,
  total_received,
  total_withdrawn,
  loan_count,
  external_counterparties,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS ext_counterparty_rank
FROM main
ORDER BY ext_counterparty_rank, account_id;

WITH tabor_branch_id AS (
  SELECT A1.code AS district_id
  FROM district A1
  WHERE A1.name = 'Tabor'
),
accounts_in_tabor AS (
  SELECT A.account_id, A.district_id, A.date AS account_opened
  FROM account A
  JOIN tabor_branch_id T ON A.district_id = T.district_id
),
owner_disp AS (
  SELECT D.account_id, D.client_id
  FROM disp D
  WHERE D.type = 'OWNER'
),
owner_profile AS (
  SELECT OD.account_id, C.birth_number, C.gender
  FROM owner_disp OD
  JOIN client C ON OD.client_id = C.client_id
),
owner_age AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         gender,
         (CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) +
          CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 96 THEN 1900 ELSE 1800 END) AS born_year,
         CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) AS born_month,
         CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS born_day
  FROM owner_profile
),
owner_age_at_1996 AS (
  SELECT account_id, gender,
      1996 - born_year - 
      CASE 
        WHEN (born_month > 12) OR (born_month = 12 AND born_day > 31) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END AS age_1996
  FROM owner_age
),
cards_by_account AS (
  SELECT C.account_id, COUNT(*) AS credit_cards_held
  FROM card C
  WHERE C.issued <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY C.account_id
),
loans_by_account AS (
  SELECT L.account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS loans_held,
         SUM(CASE WHEN L.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_B,
         SUM(CASE WHEN L.status IN ('C','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_CD,
         SUM(CASE WHEN L.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_A
  FROM loan L
  WHERE L.date <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY L.account_id
),
loan_status_label AS (
  SELECT account_id,
    CASE 
     WHEN loans_held = 0 THEN 'no loan'
     WHEN any_B > 0 THEN 'defaulted'
     WHEN any_CD > 0 THEN 'repaying'
     ELSE 'paid off'
    END AS loan_standing
  FROM loans_by_account
),
transactions_1997 AS (
  SELECT T.account_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN T.type = 'credit' AND T.date >= '1997-01-01' AND T.date <= '1997-12-31' THEN T.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
         SUM(CASE WHEN T.type IN ('debit','withdrawal') AND T.date >= '1997-01-01' AND T.date <= '1997-12-31' THEN T.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
         SUM(CASE WHEN T.date >= '1997-01-01' AND T.date <= '1997-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trans_count
  FROM trans T
  GROUP BY T.account_id
),
balances_1997 AS (
  SELECT T.account_id,
         MAX(T.balance) AS peak_balance
  FROM trans T
  WHERE T.date >= '1997-01-01' AND T.date <= '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY T.account_id
),
all_accounts AS (
  SELECT A.account_id, A.account_opened
  FROM accounts_in_tabor A
)
SELECT
  AA.account_id,
  AA.account_opened,
  OA.gender,
  OA.age_1996,
  COALESCE(CB.credit_cards_held,0) AS credit_cards_held,
  COALESCE(LB.loans_held,0) AS loans_held,
  COALESCE(LS.loan_standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
  COALESCE(T97.trans_count, 0) AS transactions_1997,
  COALESCE(T97.money_in, 0) AS money_in_1997,
  COALESCE(T97.money_out, 0) AS money_out_1997,
  COALESCE(B97.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance_1997,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(B97.peak_balance, 0) DESC, AA.account_id ASC) AS rank_by_1997_peak_balance
FROM all_accounts AA
LEFT JOIN owner_age_at_1996 OA ON AA.account_id = OA.account_id
LEFT JOIN cards_by_account CB ON AA.account_id = CB.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans_by_account LB ON AA.account_id = LB.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_status_label LS ON AA.account_id = LS.account_id
LEFT JOIN transactions_1997 T97 ON AA.account_id = T97.account_id
LEFT JOIN balances_1997 B97 ON AA.account_id = B97.account_id
ORDER BY rank_by_1997_peak_balance, AA.account_id ASC;

I'm preparing our branch's annual customer review. For every account held at the Tabor branch as of 31 December 1996, I need a one-row profile per account, ordered among tied ranks by ascending account id, showing: the account id; the date the account was opened; the owner's gender and their age at 31 December 1996 in whole completed years; the number of credit cards issued to the account by 31 December 1996 (0 if none); the number of loans approved to the account by 31 December 1996 (0 if none); a loan standing label; the number of transactions on the account during 1997; the total money into the account during 1997; the total money out of the account during 1997; the peak balance reached on the account during 1997 (0 if none); and the account's rank by 1997 peak balance, highest first, with ties sharing a rank and the next rank skipped (e.g. 1, 1, 3). All 'as of' figures are taken at 31 December 1996; activity figures cover the calendar year 1997. A card or loan counts as held if it was issued or approved on or before 31 December 1996. The loan standing label is: 'no loan' if the account had no loans approved by 31 December 1996; otherwise 'defaulted' if any of its loans has repayment status B; otherwise 'repaying' if any has status C or D; otherwise 'paid off'. Money in is the sum of credit transaction amounts; money out is the sum of debit and cash-withdrawal transaction amounts. The account owner is the person with the 'OWNER' disposition on the account; other dispositions are just additional users. Nothing beyond these fields, please.

BIRD evidence:
Loan repayment status codes: A means the contract finished and was paid off, B means the loan was not repaid (default), C means the loan is running and being repaid, D means the loan is running and the client is in debt on it. Transaction types: a credit transaction brings money into the account, a debit transaction takes money out, and a cash withdrawal takes money out in cash.

```sql
WITH tabor_branch_id AS (
  SELECT A1.code AS district_id
  FROM district A1
  WHERE A1.name = 'Tabor'
),
accounts_in_tabor AS (
  SELECT A.account_id, A.district_id, A.date AS account_opened
  FROM account A
  JOIN tabor_branch_id T ON A.district_id = T.district_id
),
owner_disp AS (
  SELECT D.account_id, D.client_id
  FROM disp D
  WHERE D.type = 'OWNER'
),
owner_profile AS (
  SELECT OD.account_id, C.birth_number, C.gender
  FROM owner_disp OD
  JOIN client C ON OD.client_id = C.client_id
),
owner_age AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         gender,
         (CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) +
          CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 96 THEN 1900 ELSE 1800 END) AS born_year,
         CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) AS born_month,
         CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS born_day
  FROM owner_profile
),
owner_age_at_1996 AS (
  SELECT account_id, gender,
      1996 - born_year - 
      CASE 
        WHEN (born_month > 12) OR (born_month = 12 AND born_day > 31) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END AS age_1996
  FROM owner_age
),
cards_by_account AS (
  SELECT C.account_id, COUNT(*) AS credit_cards_held
  FROM card C
  WHERE C.issued <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY C.account_id
),
loans_by_account AS (
  SELECT L.account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS loans_held,
         SUM(CASE WHEN L.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_B,
         SUM(CASE WHEN L.status IN ('C','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_CD,
         SUM(CASE WHEN L.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_A
  FROM loan L
  WHERE L.date <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY L.account_id
),
loan_status_label AS (
  SELECT account_id,
    CASE 
     WHEN loans_held = 0 THEN 'no loan'
     WHEN any_B > 0 THEN 'defaulted'
     WHEN any_CD > 0 THEN 'repaying'
     ELSE 'paid off'
    END AS loan_standing
  FROM loans_by_account
),
transactions_1997 AS (
  SELECT T.account_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN T.type = 'credit' AND T.date >= '1997-01-01' AND T.date <= '1997-12-31' THEN T.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
         SUM(CASE WHEN T.type IN ('debit','withdrawal') AND T.date >= '1997-01-01' AND T.date <= '1997-12-31' THEN T.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
         SUM(CASE WHEN T.date >= '1997-01-01' AND T.date <= '1997-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trans_count
  FROM trans T
  GROUP BY T.account_id
),
balances_1997 AS (
  SELECT T.account_id,
         MAX(T.balance) AS peak_balance
  FROM trans T
  WHERE T.date >= '1997-01-01' AND T.date <= '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY T.account_id
),
all_accounts AS (
  SELECT A.account_id, A.account_opened
  FROM accounts_in_tabor A
)
SELECT
  AA.account_id,
  AA.account_opened,
  OA.gender,
  OA.age_1996,
  COALESCE(CB.credit_cards_held,0) AS credit_cards_held,
  COALESCE(LB.loans_held,0) AS loans_held,
  COALESCE(LS.loan_standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
  COALESCE(T97.trans_count, 0) AS transactions_1997,
  COALESCE(T97.money_in, 0) AS money_in_1997,
  COALESCE(T97.money_out, 0) AS money_out_1997,
  COALESCE(B97.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance_1997,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(B97.peak_balance, 0) DESC, AA.account_id ASC) AS rank_by_1997_peak_balance
FROM all_accounts AA
LEFT JOIN owner_age_at_1996 OA ON AA.account_id = OA.account_id
LEFT JOIN cards_by_account CB ON AA.account_id = CB.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans_by_account LB ON AA.account_id = LB.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_status_label LS ON AA.account_id = LS.account_id
LEFT JOIN transactions_1997 T97 ON AA.account_id = T97.account_id
LEFT JOIN balances_1997 B97 ON AA.account_id = B97.account_id
ORDER BY rank_by_1997_peak_balance, AA.account_id ASC;
```

WITH classic_card_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.district_id,
        d.name AS district_name,
        cl.client_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id AND c.type = 'classic'
    JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
payments AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        t.account_id,
        t.bank,
        t.account AS ext_account,
        t.amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.bank <> ''
),
districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, name AS district_name FROM district
),
owners_with_classic_per_district AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.district_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cco.client_id) AS num_clients
    FROM districts d
    LEFT JOIN classic_card_owners cco ON d.district_id = cco.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.district_name
),
xpays AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT (p.bank || ':' || p.ext_account)) AS num_ext_accounts,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM classic_card_owners cco
    JOIN account a ON a.district_id = cco.district_id
    JOIN payments p ON p.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM disp dp2
        WHERE dp2.account_id = a.account_id AND dp2.client_id = cco.client_id AND dp2.type = 'OWNER'
    )
    GROUP BY d.district_id
    -- d needed here for join below
    JOIN districts d ON d.district_id = cco.district_id
)
SELECT
    o.district_name,
    o.num_clients,
    COALESCE(x.num_ext_accounts, 0) AS num_ext_accounts,
    COALESCE(x.total_amount, 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
FROM owners_with_classic_per_district o
LEFT JOIN xpays x ON o.district_id = x.district_id
ORDER BY
    total_outgoing_amount DESC,
    o.district_name ASC;

WITH french_gp_editions AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.date
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE c.name LIKE '%France%' AND r.year >= 1990
),
driver_fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.raceId, 
        lt.driverId,
        MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms
    FROM lapTimes lt
    GROUP BY lt.raceId, lt.driverId
),
french_gp_drivers_under_90s AS (
    SELECT 
        fge.raceId,
        fge.date,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        dfl.fastest_lap_ms
    FROM french_gp_editions fge
    JOIN driver_fastest_laps dfl ON fge.raceId = dfl.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON dfl.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE dfl.fastest_lap_ms > 90000
)
SELECT 
    e.date,
    t.forename,
    t.surname,
    CASE 
        WHEN t.fastest_lap_ms IS NOT NULL THEN
            printf('%d:%06.3f',
                CAST(t.fastest_lap_ms/60000 AS INTEGER),
                (t.fastest_lap_ms%60000)/1000.0
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS fastest_lap_m_ss_mmm
FROM french_gp_editions e
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        raceId,
        forename,
        surname,
        fastest_lap_ms
    FROM french_gp_drivers_under_90s
) t
ON e.raceId = t.raceId
ORDER BY e.date ASC, t.surname ASC, t.forename ASC;

WITH winning_drivers AS (
    SELECT
        d.driverId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        d.nationality,
        d.dob,
        r.raceId,
        r.name AS race_name,
        r.date AS race_date
    FROM results res
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE res.positionOrder = 1
),
oldest_winner AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        forename,
        surname,
        nationality,
        dob
    FROM winning_drivers
    GROUP BY driverId
    ORDER BY dob ASC, forename || ' ' || surname ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT
        wd.driverId,
        wd.race_name,
        wd.race_date
    FROM winning_drivers wd
    JOIN oldest_winner ow ON wd.driverId = ow.driverId
    -- get earliest win date; if multiple, pick alphabetically by race_name
    ORDER BY wd.race_date ASC, wd.race_name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
race_starts AS (
    SELECT
        res.driverId,
        COUNT(*) AS starts
    FROM results res
    GROUP BY res.driverId
)
SELECT
    ow.forename || ' ' || ow.surname AS full_name,
    ow.nationality,

WITH chinese_gp_2000s AS (
  SELECT ra.raceId, ra.year, ra.date, ra.time, ra.circuitId
  FROM races ra
  INNER JOIN circuits ci ON ra.circuitId = ci.circuitId
  WHERE ci.name LIKE '%Shanghai%' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009

  WHERE local_start = earliest_start
  ORDER BY year DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
runner_up_gap AS (
  SELECT
    mr.year,
    mr.local_start,
    re.positionOrder,
    re.time AS finishtime,
    re.milliseconds,
    re.raceId
  FROM most_recent_among_earliest mr
  JOIN results re ON mr.raceId = re.raceId
  WHERE re.positionOrder IN (1,2)
),
ordered_res AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positionOrder) AS rn
  FROM runner_up_gap

  -- Gap: runner-up time minus winner time, prefer 'milliseconds' if available

    r.raceId,
    c.circuitRef,

  FROM races
),

  SELECT DISTINCT c.circuitRef,

  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE strftime('%H:%M:%S', IFNULL(r.time, '00:00:00')) = (SELECT earliest_clock FROM earliest_times)
),

sql:
WITH humanities_departments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.department
    FROM major m
    WHERE m.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
dept_majors AS (
    SELECT d.department, maj.major
    FROM humanities_departments d
    JOIN major maj ON d.department = maj.department
),
majors_with_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.major
    FROM member m
    WHERE m.major IS NOT NULL
),
dept_majors_with_member_flag AS (
    SELECT
        dm.department,
        dm.major,
        CASE WHEN mwm.major IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_member
    FROM dept_majors dm
    LEFT JOIN majors_with_members mwm ON dm.major = mwm.major
),
members_per_major AS (
    SELECT
        ma.department,
        ma.major,
        COUNT(mem.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM dept_majors ma
    LEFT JOIN member mem ON ma.major = mem.major
    GROUP BY ma.department, ma.major
),
avg_members_per_major AS (
    SELECT
        department,
        ROUND(AVG(member_count * 1.0), 2) AS avg_members_per_major
    FROM members_per_major
    GROUP BY department
),
member_held_majors AS (
    SELECT
        dm.department,
        GROUP_CONCAT(dm.major, ', ') AS majors_offered,
        GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN dm.has_member = 1 THEN dm.major ELSE NULL END, ', ') AS member_held_majors
    FROM dept_majors_with_member_flag dm
    GROUP BY dm.department
)
SELECT
    mh.department,
    mh.majors_offered,
    mh.member_held_majors,
    am.avg_members_per_major
FROM member_held_majors mh
JOIN avg_members_per_major am ON mh.department = am.department
ORDER BY mh.department;

WITH humanities_departments AS (

    WHERE m.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'

    FROM humanities_departments d
    JOIN major maj ON d.department = maj.department
),
majors_with_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.major
    FROM member m
    WHERE m.major IS NOT NULL
),

WITH over_budget_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.event_id
  FROM event e
  JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.event_id
  JOIN expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.budget_id
  GROUP BY b.budget_id
  HAVING SUM(b.amount) - SUM(ex.amount) < 0
),
event_expenses AS (
  SELECT ex.expense_id, ex.description
  FROM expense ex
  WHERE ex.event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM over_budget_events)
),
kinds AS (
  -- Split descriptions by comma, trim whitespace, and get distinct items

WITH event_totals AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.name,
    SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget,
    SUM(b.spent) AS total_spending
  FROM event e
  LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.event_id
  WHERE e.status = 'closed'
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.name
),
purchase_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ev.event_id,
    ev.name,
    COALESCE(SUM(ex.item_count), 0) AS total_purchases
  FROM event_totals ev
  LEFT JOIN expense ex ON ev.event_id = ex.event_id
  GROUP BY ev.event_id, ev.name
),
eligible_events AS (
  SELECT
    pc.event_id,
    pc.name,
    pc.total_purchases
  FROM purchase_counts pc
  JOIN event_totals et ON pc.event_id = et.event_id
  WHERE IFNULL(et.total_spending, 0) <= IFNULL(et.total_budget, 0)
)
SELECT name
FROM eligible_events
ORDER BY total_purchases DESC, event_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

  JOIN superhero s ON hp.hero_id = s.id
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

)

sql:
WITH full_named_heroes AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.gender_id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
    WHERE
        s.full_name IS NOT NULL
        AND LENGTH(TRIM(s.full_name)) > 0
        -- at least one space in name for "first name plus last name"
        AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
)
, hero_gender_counts AS (
    SELECT
        g.gender,
        COUNT(fnh.id) AS hero_count
    FROM gender g
    LEFT JOIN full_named_heroes fnh ON g.id = fnh.gender_id
    WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
    GROUP BY g.gender
)
, hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT
        fnh.gender_id,
        COUNT(hp.superhero_id) AS total_powers
    FROM full_named_heroes fnh
    LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.superhero_id = fnh.id
    GROUP BY fnh.gender_id
)
SELECT
    g.gender,
    ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(hp.total_powers, 0) AS FLOAT) / 
          CASE WHEN hc.hero_count > 0 THEN hc.hero_count ELSE 1 END, 2) AS avg_superpowers_per_hero
FROM gender g
LEFT JOIN hero_gender_counts hc ON hc.gender = g.gender
LEFT JOIN hero_power_counts hp ON hp.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
ORDER BY g.gender

WITH anti_rnp_tests AS (
  SELECT 
    Laboratory.id AS lab_test_id,
    Laboratory.patient_id,
    Laboratory.examination_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Laboratory.test_name = 'anti-RNP antibody' THEN Laboratory.result_value END) AS anti_rnp_result,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Laboratory.test_name = 'total serum bilirubin' THEN Laboratory.result_value END) AS total_bilirubin
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY Laboratory.id, Laboratory.patient_id, Laboratory.examination_date
),
strongest_anti_rnp AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM anti_rnp_tests
  WHERE anti_rnp_result = (SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_result) FROM anti_rnp_tests)
),
max_bilirubin AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_bilirubin) AS max_total_bilirubin
  FROM strongest_anti_rnp
)
SELECT
  s.lab_test_id,
  s.total_bilirubin,
  s.examination_date,
  p.id AS patient_id,
  p.sex,
  p.birthday
FROM strongest_anti_rnp s
JOIN max_bilirubin m ON s.total_bilirubin = m.max_total_bilirubin
JOIN Patient p ON s.patient_id = p.id
WHERE s.total_bilirubin IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.lab_test_id;

WITH exact_overlap_patients AS (
  SELECT
    p.patient_id
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.patient_id = e.patient_id
  WHERE e.suspected = 0
    AND e.code IN ('RA', 'SJS')
  GROUP BY p.patient_id
  HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.code IN ('RA','SJS') THEN e.code END) = 2
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT e.code) = 2
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN e.suspected = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*)
),
labs_with_platelet AS (
  SELECT
    l.patient_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN l.platelet_count > 100 AND l.platelet_count < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_normal_platelet
  FROM Laboratory l
  GROUP BY l.patient_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN lw.has_normal_platelet = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_normal_platelet_result,
  SUM(CASE WHEN lw.has_normal_platelet IS NULL OR lw.has_normal_platelet = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_never_normal_platelet_result
FROM exact_overlap_patients p
LEFT JOIN labs_with_platelet lw ON p.patient_id = lw.patient_id;

)

FROM abnormal_tp_records;

WITH thrombosis_women AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.PatientID
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.Gender = 'Female' AND p.Cohort = 'Thrombosis'
),
anti_rnp_results AS (
    SELECT e.PatientID, e.Titer
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.TestName = 'Anti-ribonuclear protein'
),
latest_results AS (
    SELECT a.PatientID, MAX(a.Titer) AS Titer
    FROM anti_rnp_results a
    JOIN thrombosis_women tw ON a.PatientID = tw.PatientID
    GROUP BY a.PatientID
),
available_results AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM latest_results
    WHERE Titer IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN
            -- Parse the titer: "1:XXX", must be strictly above 1:64, or accept 'Negative'/'0' as not elevated
            CASE 
                WHEN Titer = 'Negative' OR Titer = '0' THEN 0
                WHEN Titer LIKE '1:%' AND CAST(SUBSTR(Titer, 3) AS INTEGER) > 64 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2
    ) AS percent_clearly_elevated
FROM available_results

I'm preparing a department audit on how often anti-ribonuclear protein testing comes back clearly elevated among the women in the thrombosis cohort. Among the women in the cohort, what percentage of those with an available anti-ribonuclear protein test result had a clearly elevated result? Please give me the percentage rounded to two decimal places on the 0-100 scale. Note: elevated means a titer strictly above 1:64. Patients never tested for anti-ribonuclear protein should be excluded from both the numerator and the denominator, while a negative reading counts as an available result and is never elevated.

BIRD evidence:
Anti-ribonuclear protein is a serology test reported as a titer reading; a negative reading is a result of zero titer.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

answer:
```sql
WITH thrombosis_women AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.PatientID
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.Gender = 'Female' AND p.Cohort = 'Thrombosis'
),
anti_rnp_results AS (
    SELECT e.PatientID, e.Titer
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.TestName = 'Anti-ribonuclear protein'
),
latest_results AS (
    SELECT a.PatientID, MAX(a.Titer) AS Titer
    FROM anti_rnp_results a
    JOIN thrombosis_women tw ON a.PatientID = tw.PatientID
    GROUP BY a.PatientID
),
available_results AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM latest_results
    WHERE Titer IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN
            -- Parse the titer: "1:XXX", must be strictly above 1:64, or accept 'Negative'/'0' as not elevated
            CASE 
                WHEN Titer = 'Negative' OR Titer = '0' THEN 0
                WHEN Titer LIKE '1:%' AND CAST(SUBSTR(Titer, 3) AS INTEGER) > 64 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2
    ) AS percent_clearly_elevated
FROM available_results
;
```

WITH ldh_lab AS (
  SELECT
    Laboratory.patient_id,
    Laboratory.visit_id
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Laboratory.lab_name = 'LDH'
    AND CAST(Laboratory.result AS FLOAT) > 600
    AND CAST(Laboratory.result AS FLOAT) < 800
),
protein_lab AS (
  SELECT
    Laboratory.patient_id,
    Laboratory.visit_id
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Laboratory.lab_name = 'Urine Protein'
    AND (
      (result NOT IN ('-', 'TR')
        AND (
          -- Numeric results
          (
            CAST(result AS FLOAT) >= 300
          )
          OR
          -- Qualitative descriptions with 'at least' (e.g. "at least 300")
          (
            LOWER(result) LIKE 'at least%'
            AND
              -- Extract numeric value after 'at least' and test >= 300
              CAST(
                TRIM(
                  SUBSTR(result, INSTR(result, 'at least') + LENGTH('at least'))
                ) 
                AS FLOAT
              ) >= 300
          )
        )
      )
    )
),
qualifying_visits AS (
  SELECT
    ldh_lab.patient_id,
    ldh_lab.visit_id
  FROM ldh_lab
  INNER JOIN protein_lab
    ON ldh_lab.patient_id = protein_lab.patient_id
    AND ldh_lab.visit_id = protein_lab.visit_id
),
patients_with_single_qualifying_visit AS (
  SELECT
    patient_id
  FROM qualifying_visits
  GROUP BY patient_id
  HAVING COUNT(visit_id) = 1
)
SELECT
  p.patient_id,
  CAST(
    (strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') - strftime('%Y', p.birth_date)) - 
    (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.birth_date))
    AS INTEGER
  ) AS completed_age
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.patient_id IN (
  SELECT patient_id FROM patients_with_single_qualifying_visit
)
ORDER BY p.patient_id;

    Laboratory.visit_id
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Laboratory.lab_name = 'LDH'
    AND CAST(Laboratory.result AS FLOAT) > 600

WITH first_labs AS (
  SELECT
    Laboratory.patient_id,
    Laboratory.lab_test_date,

)

WHERE got_value IS NOT NULL

  AND rnp_value IS NOT NULL

WITH Inpatients AS (
  SELECT PatientID, Diagnosis, date(BirthDate) AS BirthDate
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission = '+'
),
AntiDNATests AS (
  SELECT 
    l.LabID,
    l.PatientID,
    date(l.TestDate) AS TestDate,
    l."anti-DNA antibody" AS AntiDNALevel
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l."anti-DNA antibody" IS NOT NULL
),
MaxAntiDNATest AS (
  SELECT 
    a.PatientID,
    a.TestDate,
    a.AntiDNALevel
  FROM AntiDNATests a
  WHERE (a.PatientID, a.AntiDNALevel, a.TestDate) IN (
    SELECT 
      at.PatientID, 
      at.AntiDNALevel,
      MIN(at.TestDate)
    FROM AntiDNATests at
    WHERE at.AntiDNALevel = (
      SELECT MAX("anti-DNA antibody") FROM AntiDNATests
    )
    GROUP BY at.PatientID, at.AntiDNALevel
  )
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  ip.PatientID,
  ip.Diagnosis,
  MAXAD.AntiDNALevel,
  MAXAD.TestDate,
  (CAST(strftime('%Y', MAXAD.TestDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', ip.BirthDate) AS INTEGER)
    - (strftime('%m-%d', MAXAD.TestDate) < strftime('%m-%d', ip.BirthDate))) AS Age_Completed_Years
FROM Inpatients ip
JOIN MaxAntiDNATest MAXAD ON ip.PatientID = MAXAD.PatientID;

  diagnosis
FROM
  EligibleFirstSeen
ORDER BY
  julianday(visit_date) - julianday(birth_date) DESC, -- oldest age at intake
  patient_id ASC

WITH low_rbc_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.patient_id
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Laboratory.test_name = 'RBC'
    AND Laboratory.result_value < 3.5

ORDER BY admission_status DESC

WITH patients_in_range AS (
  SELECT PatientID, Sex
  FROM Patient
  WHERE DateOfBirth BETWEEN '1936-01-01' AND '1956-12-31'
),
cpk_results AS (
  SELECT p.PatientID, MAX(CAST(l.ResultValue AS FLOAT)) AS max_cpk
  FROM patients_in_range p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.PatientID = l.PatientID AND l.TestName = 'CPK'
  GROUP BY p.PatientID
),
eligible_patients AS (
  SELECT p.PatientID, p.Sex
  FROM patients_in_range p
  JOIN cpk_results c ON p.PatientID = c.PatientID
  WHERE c.max_cpk IS NULL OR c.max_cpk < 250
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Sex IN ('F', 'M') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT)
  , 1
  ) AS women_percentage
FROM eligible_patients
WHERE Sex IN ('F', 'M');

WITH
carbon_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_carbon
  FROM atom
  WHERE atom.element = 'C'
  GROUP BY atom.molecule_id
),
chlorine_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_chlorine
  FROM atom
  WHERE atom.element = 'Cl'
  GROUP BY atom.molecule_id
),
atom_counts AS (
  SELECT atom.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY atom.molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT bond.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_bonds
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY bond.molecule_id
),
carbon_touching_bonds AS (
  -- Count each bond once if it touches a carbon atom (use LEAST+GREATEST to avoid double-counting C-C bonds)
  SELECT
    b.molecule_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.atom1_id = a1.id
  JOIN atom a2 ON b.atom2_id = a2.id
  WHERE a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
multiple_bonds AS (
  SELECT bond.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_multiple_bonds
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond.bond_type IN ('double','triple')
  GROUP BY bond.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  m.id AS molecule_id,
  m.carcinogenicity_label,
  COALESCE(a.num_atoms, 0) AS num_atoms,
  COALESCE(bc.num_bonds, 0) AS num_bonds,
  COALESCE(ca.num_carbon, 0) AS num_carbon,
  COALESCE(cl.num_chlorine, 0) AS num_chlorine,
  COALESCE(ctb.num_carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
  COALESCE(mb.num_multiple_bonds, 0) AS num_multiple_bonds,
  RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY COALESCE(ctb.num_carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC,
             COALESCE(a.num_atoms, 0) DESC,
             m.id ASC
  ) AS rank
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom_counts a ON m.id = a.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON m.id = bc.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN carbon_atoms ca ON m.id = ca.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN chlorine_atoms cl ON m.id = cl.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN carbon_touching_bonds ctb ON m.id = ctb.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN multiple_bonds mb ON m.id = mb.molecule_id
WHERE COALESCE(ca.num_carbon, 0) >= 1
ORDER BY
  num_carbon_touching_bonds DESC,
  num_atoms DESC,
  molecule_id ASC
;

sql:
WITH atom_bond_info AS (
  SELECT
    a.id AS atom_id,
    a.element,
    COUNT(b.id) AS total_bonds,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 END) AS single_bonds,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 END) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM atom a
  JOIN bond b ON a.id = b.atom1_id OR a.id = b.atom2_id
  GROUP BY a.id, a.element
)
SELECT
  element,
  COUNT(atom_id) AS saturated_atom_count
FROM atom_bond_info
WHERE
  total_bonds > 0 -- exclude atoms with no bonds
  AND multiple_bonds = 0 -- never part of any multiple bond
  AND total_bonds = single_bonds -- all bonds are single
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;
